messages:
maria_ae: Partner (large SI) asked for an OCI + AWS hybrid refkit that shows how to run inference on Oracle Ampere instances with an AWS uplink for training and model sync. Deliverables: terraform modules, example network topology, packaging checklist. Quick owners?

sam_k: I can do CI + multi-arch image builds. Curious: will marketplace require an OCI image registry (OCIR) mirror or is a public ghcr fine?

partner_pm: OCI prefers OCIR for listings but accepts a mirrored public registry for reviews. Ideally provide OCIR instructions and a mirrored ghcr reference. Also want a network diagram and a clear note on VCN <> VPC connectivity patterns.

leah_h: I'll own the Terraform module for OCI side (ampere_pool) and produce a minimal example that provisions a VCN, subnet, and an Ampere compute pool. Expose variables: region, shape (e.g. BM.A1.MICRO), node_count, image_ocid, and marketplace_tag.

yusuf_m: I'll handle the AWS uplink module. It should create a Transit Gateway peering (or use FastConnect) example and a small EC2 training instance type (e.g. c7a.xlarge) with IAM snippet to pull models from OCIR.

sam_k: CI flow: buildx for amd64+arm64, push multi-arch manifest to ghcr and script to push a copy to OCIR. Add smoke-deploy job that runs a terraform apply against a partner sandbox.

leah_h: Terraform example snippet to include in repo (example usage):```hcl
module "oci_ampere" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//oci/ampere-pool"
  region = "phx"
  shape = "BM.A1.2"
  node_count = 2
  image_ocid = var.image_ocid
  marketplace_tag = "v1.0-oci"
}
```

yusuf_m: AWS uplink module snippet:```hcl
module "aws_uplink" {
  source = "github.com/redwood-inference/refkits//aws/uplink"
  vpc_id = var.vpc_id
  tgw_attachment = true
  mirror_to_ocir = true
}
```

packaging_bot: Partner workspace created: https://redwood-internal/partners/spaces/oci-aws-hybrid-refkit. Checklist attached. :white_check_mark:

partner_pm: Important: include a short section in README about data egress/costs and recommended encryption-in-transit (mutual TLS) for cross-cloud traffic. Reviewers flagged this in past listings.

sam_k: We'll add a demo script that deploys the modules and then runs a quick inference call. Smoke curl (to include in repo):```bash
TOKEN=<TEST_TOKEN>
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"hello"}' https://$DEMO_IP/serve/v1/generate | jq '.output'
```

leah_h: Also adding outputs.tf to surface `demo_ip`, `ampere_pool_ids`, and `ocir_image_ref` so demo automation can find artifacts.

yusuf_m: Security note: include IAM role example for the AWS training instance to read model blobs from OCIR (or from a signed S3 presigned URL). Add KMS/CMEK examples for both OCI and AWS.

maria_ae: timeline: partner wants a walkthrough next Thursday. Let's aim to freeze artifacts by Tuesday EOD. Owners: leah_h = oci module + docs, yusuf_m = aws uplink + network guide, sam_k = CI/images + smoke deploy, partner_pm = partner coordination + demo.

leah_h: I'll add a small 'fallback' section: route to a CPU-only replica in the same VCN if Ampere nodes are unavailable. quick policy example will be in docs.

sam_k: I'll add a nightly job that runs the cross-cloud smoke test against the private demo. If networking fails, the job will post a snippet of `traceroute` to the thread for debugging.

partner_pm: Great. Please link the demo environment and invite the SI reviewers to the partner workspace when ready.

maria_ae: Thanks team — quick sync tomorrow 9am PT to validate the demo flow. Ping here if you need any quota or OCIR permissions. :rocket:
